title: Shared definitions
description: Building blocks reused by the other schemas.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.

utc_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 in UTC with a trailing Z. Convert to America/Sao_Paulo only for display.

date.description: A calendar date, for example 2026-11-02. In hand-edited files it is a plain date, with no time zone.

long_text.description: Free text for notes and sources in hand-edited files.
